planets.name: TOI-406 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-406 with a 13.2-day year, found in 2024.

text.card: TOI-406 b was found in 2024 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 2 planets known around TOI-406. Its orbit and size follow Lacedelli et al. 2024's fit, the archive's default.
